camel_example: aliyun csas CreateWmInfoMapping --region cn-hangzhou --WmInfoBytesB64 aGVsbG8gc2F00000 --WmType PureDocument
description_en: Creates a mapping from string-format watermark information to digital-format watermark information
description_zh: 创建一条字符串格式的水印信息到数字格式的水印信息的映射关系
kebab_example: aliyun csas create-wm-info-mapping --wm-type PureDocument --wm-info-bytes-b64 aGVsbG8gc2F00000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateWmInfoMapping

parameters.help_en:
Watermark type. Valid values:
PureWebappInvisible: Webpage watermark.
PureAppInvisible: App watermark.
PureScreenInvisible: Screen watermark.
PureDocument: Document watermark.
PureImage: Image watermark.
PureAudio: Audio watermark.
PureVideo: Video watermark.
AigcWebappInvisible: AIGC webpage watermark.
AigcAppInvisible: AIGC App watermark.
AigcScreenInvisible: AIGC screen watermark.
AigcDocument: AIGC document watermark.
AigcImage: AIGC image watermark.
AigcAudio: AIGC audio watermark.
AigcVideo: AIGC video watermark
parameters.help_zh:

parameters.name: wm_type

parameters.help_en: The capacity bit width of the watermark information. Default is 32. This parameter must be consistent with the capacity bit width used during actual embedding or transparent image generation. Valid range: 32 to 64
parameters.help_zh: 水印信息的容量位宽，默认为32。该参数应该和实际嵌入或者生成透明图时的容量位宽保持一致。取值范围：32~64
parameters.name: wm_info_size

parameters.help_en: The Base64-encoded string-format watermark information. Length: 1 to 300 characters
parameters.help_zh: Base64编码后的字符串格式水印信息 。长度1～300个字符
parameters.name: wm_info_bytes_b64

WmInfoUint.description_en: The mapped digital-format watermark information. This value can be used to look up the corresponding string-format watermark information
WmInfoUint.description_zh: 映射得到的数字格式的水印信息。后续可以使用该值查找到对应映射的字符串格式的水印信息
